capabilities: complete or reopen tasks with a single click
cancel tasks with a double click
set in-progress, deferred and other statuses via right-click
highlight tasks by status with colors and icons
extras: Installable manually or via BRAT; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README states it uses no network access or external dependencies.
problem: Obsidian task checkboxes only toggle between two states with a single click, so workflows needing cancelled, in-progress or deferred statuses have no click-based way to set them.
summary: Task checkbox enhancement that adds five task statuses and click or right-click controls for completing, cancelling and deferring tasks.
